nodes.name: hooks_dispatch.rs
nodes.summary: Bridges the turn event handler to the lifecycle hooks system, running PreToolUse/Stop/PostToolUse hooks during an agent turn and translating hook results into tool-blocking decisions, stop-check overrides, and LSP diagnostics context.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses exit-code-2 as a blocking-feedback contract for PreToolUse hooks, mirroring common hook ecosystem conventions.

nodes.name: dispatch_pre_tool
nodes.summary: Runs PreToolUse hooks before a tool executes and converts an exit-code-2 or JSON-decision hook result into a tool-blocking intervention with feedback text.

nodes.name: dispatch_stop_check
nodes.summary: Runs Stop-event hooks after a turn completes and inspects their output to decide whether the agent loop should be blocked from stopping.

nodes.name: parse_stop_block
nodes.summary: Parses a Stop hook's stderr as either a raw string or a `{"block": bool, "reason": string}` JSON object to extract a block decision and reason.

nodes.name: dispatch_post_tool
nodes.summary: Runs PostToolUseFailure/PostToolUse hooks after a tool call finishes and, for edit-like tools, triggers LSP diagnostics collection on the modified file.

nodes.name: lsp_post_edit_diagnostics
nodes.summary: Fetches LSP diagnostics for a file modified by an Edit/Write-style tool call and formats them as hook context for downstream consumption.

nodes.name: extract_modified_file_path
nodes.summary: Extracts the target file path from a tool call's JSON arguments for Edit/Write/MultiEdit-style tools.

nodes.name: commands.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri commands and orchestration logic for detecting and applying external agent artifacts (rules, skills, MCP servers, agent definitions) from other coding tools into ORGII's own Policy/Skill/MCP/AgentDefinition primitives.

nodes.name: external_import_detect
nodes.summary: Tauri command that runs detection across all supported external tools and returns the list of importable items found on disk.

nodes.name: external_import_apply
nodes.summary: Tauri command that applies a user's selected import items, delegating to `apply_selections`.

nodes.name: apply_selections
nodes.summary: Applies a batch of import selections one at a time, collecting a per-item report for each.

nodes.name: apply_single
nodes.summary: Dispatches a single import selection to the appropriate handler based on its `ItemKind` (Policy, Skill, Mcp, AgentDefinition) and builds a result report.

nodes.name: apply_policy_import
nodes.summary: Imports a rule-flavored external artifact as an ORGII Policy, writing the policy config file into the workspace.

nodes.name: write_imported_policy_config
nodes.summary: Writes a newly imported policy's config entry to the workspace policy store.

nodes.name: apply_skill_import
nodes.summary: Copies an external skill directory (SKILL.md plus assets) into ORGII's skills directory, recursively duplicating its contents.

nodes.name: copy_dir_recursive
nodes.summary: Recursively copies a directory tree from one filesystem path to another, used when importing external skill bundles.

nodes.name: load_external_mcp_config
nodes.summary: Loads and parses an external tool's MCP server config file (e.g. Claude Desktop's mcp-servers.json) prior to import.

nodes.name: apply_mcp_import
nodes.summary: Imports a single MCP server entry detected from an external tool's config into ORGII's own MCP server config file.

nodes.name: apply_agent_definition_import
nodes.summary: Imports an external agent-definition markdown file (with YAML frontmatter) into ORGII's AgentDefinitionsStore, splitting frontmatter from body content.

nodes.name: split_frontmatter_for_apply
nodes.summary: Splits a markdown document's YAML frontmatter key/value pairs from its body text for agent-definition import.

nodes.name: claude_code.rs
nodes.summary: Detects Claude Code artifacts on the user's machine — CLAUDE.md memory files, agents, skills (~/.claude/skills), and slash commands (~/.claude/commands) — as candidates for import into ORGII.

nodes.name: detect_claude_code_memory
nodes.summary: Scans for CLAUDE.md memory files (global and per-repo) and builds detected-item previews for them.

nodes.name: build_claude_memory_item
nodes.summary: Builds a `DetectedItem` preview for a discovered CLAUDE.md file, including a first-line summary and fidelity warnings.

nodes.name: detect_claude_code_agents
nodes.summary: Detects Claude Code agent-definition markdown files under ~/.claude/agents.

nodes.name: detect_claude_code_skills
nodes.summary: Detects Claude Code skills and slash-commands by scanning both the skills and commands directories.

nodes.name: scan_claude_skills_dir
nodes.summary: Walks ~/.claude/skills for SKILL.md files and builds detected-item previews for each.

nodes.name: scan_claude_commands_dir
nodes.summary: Walks ~/.claude/commands for markdown slash-command files and builds detected-item previews for each.

nodes.name: build_claude_skill_item
nodes.summary: Builds a `DetectedItem` preview for a discovered Claude Code skill or command file, including fidelity warnings for unsupported features.

nodes.name: codex.rs
nodes.summary: Detects OpenAI Codex CLI artifacts (AGENTS.md files) on the user's machine as import candidates.

nodes.name: detect_codex_agents_md
nodes.summary: Scans for Codex AGENTS.md files (global and per-repo) and builds detected-item previews for them.

nodes.name: build_codex_agents_item
nodes.summary: Builds a `DetectedItem` preview for a discovered Codex AGENTS.md file.

nodes.name: detect_codex_agents
nodes.summary: Entry point that aggregates detection of Codex AGENTS.md artifacts.

nodes.name: copilot.rs
nodes.summary: Detects GitHub Copilot artifacts — repo-level and scoped copilot-instructions.md files, plus custom agent/chatmode files — as import candidates.

nodes.name: detect_copilot_instructions
nodes.summary: Detects both single-file and path-scoped Copilot instructions files and builds preview items for each.

nodes.name: build_copilot_single_item
nodes.summary: Builds a `DetectedItem` preview for the repo-root copilot-instructions.md file.

nodes.name: build_copilot_scoped_item
nodes.summary: Builds a `DetectedItem` preview for a path-scoped `.github/instructions/*.instructions.md` file, including its glob scope.

nodes.name: detect_copilot_agents
nodes.summary: Detects Copilot custom agent/chatmode files by scanning the relevant directory.

nodes.name: scan_copilot_dir
nodes.summary: Walks a Copilot agents directory for chatmode markdown files and builds detected-item previews for each.

nodes.name: build_copilot_agent_item
nodes.summary: Builds a `DetectedItem` preview for a discovered Copilot agent/chatmode file.

nodes.name: cursor.rs
nodes.summary: Detects Cursor IDE artifacts — `.mdc` rule files and skills (repo-local and global) — as import candidates.

nodes.name: detect_cursor_rules
nodes.summary: Detects Cursor `.cursor/rules/*.mdc` rule files in the current repository and builds preview items for them.

nodes.name: scan_cursor_rule_dir
nodes.summary: Walks a Cursor rules directory for `.mdc` files and builds detected-item previews for each.

nodes.name: build_cursor_rule_item
nodes.summary: Builds a `DetectedItem` preview for a discovered Cursor `.mdc` rule file, parsing its frontmatter metadata.

nodes.name: detect_cursor_agents
nodes.summary: Placeholder/entry point for Cursor agent-definition detection (Cursor has no native agent-definition concept).

nodes.name: detect_cursor_skills
nodes.summary: Detects Cursor skills from both repo-local and global skills directories.

nodes.name: scan_cursor_skills_dir
nodes.summary: Walks a Cursor skills directory for SKILL.md files and builds detected-item previews for each.

nodes.name: build_cursor_skill_item
nodes.summary: Builds a `DetectedItem` preview for a discovered Cursor skill file.

nodes.name: helpers.rs
nodes.summary: Shared filesystem and frontmatter-parsing helpers used by every per-tool detector module, plus already-imported checks against ORGII's own Policy/Skill/MCP/AgentDefinition stores.

nodes.name: split_frontmatter
nodes.summary: Splits a markdown document's leading `---` YAML frontmatter block from its body text, returning both parts.

nodes.name: first_body_line
nodes.summary: Extracts the first non-empty line of a document body, used to build a short content preview.

nodes.name: path_has_denied_ancestor
nodes.summary: Checks whether a candidate path lives under a denylisted ancestor directory (e.g. node_modules, .git) that should be excluded from scanning.

nodes.name: orgii_target_exists
nodes.summary: Checks whether an ORGII Policy with a given name already exists, used to flag already-imported items.

nodes.name: orgii_skill_exists
nodes.summary: Checks whether an ORGII Skill with a given name already exists, used to flag already-imported items.

nodes.name: orgii_mcp_exists
nodes.summary: Checks whether an MCP server with a given name is already configured in ORGII's merged MCP config.

nodes.name: orgii_agent_definition_exists
nodes.summary: Checks whether an ORGII AgentDefinition with a given name already exists, used to flag already-imported items.

nodes.name: home_dir
nodes.summary: Resolves the current user's home directory, used as the base for scanning global tool config locations.

nodes.name: codex_home_dir
nodes.summary: Resolves the Codex CLI home directory (respecting the CODEX_HOME override), used by the Codex detector.

nodes.name: kiro.rs
nodes.summary: Detects Kiro steering documents (rule-flavored artifacts) as import candidates.

nodes.name: detect_kiro_steering
nodes.summary: Scans the Kiro steering directory for markdown documents and builds detected-item previews for each as Policy import candidates.
